resources.string: Tap the mic and give a command.
Or type a command, e.g. open youtube
Full phone control: OFF — needed for back, home, tap, type, scroll, screenshot, lock, and for wake-word commands to open apps.
Lets My Phone press buttons, go back or home, scroll, type text, take screenshots and lock the screen when you ask by voice. My Phone does not collect or send what is on your screen.
Claude AI: ON — questions and anything I don\'t recognise go to Claude. Save an empty key to turn it off.
Claude AI: OFF — add an API key from console.anthropic.com to answer questions and understand free-form Telugu.
Speech recognition is not available. Install or update the Google app.

Try saying:
• Hello my phone, open YouTube
• Search Telugu songs on YouTube
• Call Amma / Amma ki call cheyi
• Send WhatsApp to Ravi saying I am coming
• Navigate to Hyderabad railway station
• Set alarm for 6:30 am / Set timer for 5 minutes
• Turn on flashlight / Volume up
• Take a photo / Take a screenshot
• Go back / Go home / Scroll down
• Click Subscribe / Type hello
• What time is it? / Battery
• Who won yesterday's cricket match? (Claude)
• ఈరోజు హైదరాబాద్ వాతావరణం ఎలా ఉంది? (Claude)
• Open WiFi settings
• Stop
